papers.key_finding: Total ARG abundance was 1.81-fold higher in RAS than in PFRS despite improved water quality, and co-occurrence networks showed modular associations among species, ARGs, and MGEs.
papers.title: Unexpected enrichment of antibiotic resistance genes in recirculating aquaculture effluents of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss): microbial community assembly and mobile genetic elements as key drivers
papers.tldr: Recirculating aquaculture effluents had lower conventional pollutants but higher antibiotic resistance gene abundance than flow-through systems, with distinct microbial community structuring and association networks.
papers.why_relevant: This connects to Fangzhou Xiao's interest in microbial community ecology and antibiotic resistance, illustrating how environmental management interacts with microbial genetic elements.

papers.key_finding: The set of positive algebraic numbers equals the set of reals computable by Lyapunov CRNs and 1-species RevCRNs, and detailed-balanced RevCRNs compute a subset of algebraic numbers.
papers.title: RevCRN: Reversible Analog Computation using Chemical Reaction Networks
papers.tldr: This preprint establishes computability relationships between real numbers computed by reversible chemical reaction networks and other CRN classes, including results on algebraic numbers and detailed-balanced networks.
papers.why_relevant: As an enabling-method wildcard with no biology content, this provides theoretical foundations for designing reversible biomolecular computing circuits that could be used for biological modeling or synthetic cellular computation.

papers.key_finding: Microbial community analysis showed dominance of Pseudomonas, Acinetobacter, and Geobacter, linking hydrocarbon degradation and electron transfer to system performance.
papers.title: Sustainable remediation of petroleum-contaminated river using a bioaugmented constructed wetland–microbial fuel cell: Process performance and microbial community insights
papers.tldr: A constructed wetland–microbial fuel cell with bioaugmentation and mixed vegetation removed over 75% of petroleum hydrocarbons from contaminated river water while generating peak power density of 173 mW m−2.
papers.why_relevant: This aligns with Fangzhou Xiao's interests in microbial populations and community function, particularly the role of specific taxa in biodegradation and bioelectricity generation.

papers.key_finding: Volcanic zones with extreme conditions selected for specialized taxa like Hydrogenophaga and Acidiphilium, while transitional zones showed the highest microbial diversity, integrating chemosynthetic and heterotrophic processes.
papers.title: Riverine microbial communities in an upper watershed: Integrating volcanic and anthropogenic influences
papers.tldr: Microbial community composition in the Upper Cimanuk River is structured by volcanic and anthropogenic gradients, with distinct extremophile communities in volcanic hazard zones and highest diversity in transitional zones.
papers.why_relevant: This directly relates to Fangzhou Xiao's work on microbial population dynamics and community ecology, highlighting how environmental filters shape community composition and diversity.

papers.key_finding: Generalist herbivory enriched nutrient-tolerant bacteria and led to deterministic community assembly, while specialist herbivory promoted organic matter-decomposing bacteria and stochastic assembly.
papers.title: Aboveground herbivory differentially regulates belowground bacterial communities and soil functions in an invasive weed
papers.tldr: Herbivory by a specialist beetle and a generalist moth differentially affected rhizosphere bacterial communities and soil functions in invasive Ambrosia artemisiifolia.
papers.why_relevant: This connects to Fangzhou Xiao's interest in microbial community assembly and ecological interactions, showing how aboveground herbivory regulates belowground microbial processes.

papers.key_finding: Cross-environment lineage sharing is associated with lower nucleotide diversity, and pH shows strong non-linear associations with microbial diversity and resistome composition.
papers.title: Citywide metagenomics reveals microbial community and resistome dynamics in urban wastewater
papers.tldr: A citywide metagenomic survey of urban wastewater revealed source-specific microbial communities and resistome profiles, with hospitals harboring the most diverse resistomes and treatment plants accumulating ARGs from multiple sources.
papers.why_relevant: This relates to Fangzhou Xiao's focus on microbial population dynamics and antibiotic resistance, providing insights into the dissemination of resistance genes in interconnected urban wastewater networks.

papers.key_finding: Quorum sensing signaling molecules and collective behavior regulation are proposed as mechanisms for rumen microbiota to maintain fermentation homeostasis under stress, but direct evidence is limited.
papers.title: The Potential Role of Quorum Sensing in Rumen Microbial Adaptation to Environmental and Nutritional Stress: A Review
papers.tldr: This review discusses the potential role of quorum sensing in rumen microbial adaptation to environmental and nutritional stress, summarizing current evidence and knowledge gaps.
papers.why_relevant: This ties into Fangzhou Xiao's interests in microbial decision-making and community ecology, specifically how intercellular communication may coordinate microbial behavior in complex ecosystems.

papers.key_finding: Salt-sensitive phyla were replaced by salt-tolerant ones with increasing salinity, and assembly shifted from stochastic in low/moderate salinity to deterministic in high salinity.
papers.title: From structure to assembly processes: how salinity regulates soil bacterial communities in arid regions
papers.tldr: Soil bacterial community structure and assembly processes varied along a natural salinity gradient, with deterministic processes dominating in heavily salinized soils and reduced network complexity.
papers.why_relevant: This addresses Fangzhou Xiao's interest in microbial community assembly and environmental filtering, providing an example of how abiotic stress shapes bacterial community structure and function.
